verdict.rationale: Antigravity has its own programmatic surfaces. The Python Agent SDK claims "the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Google Antigravity," and a headless CLI mode supports scripting, CI pipelines and machine-readable output. The evidence covers only the agent core, though, not full parity with UI features such as Projects, Scheduled Tasks, Artifact review and comments, Remote Control, or settings. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on all candidate paths. missing for 10: documented API/UI parity across all features, programmatic control of Projects, scheduled tasks and artifact review, a published API spec such as OpenAPI, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Google Antigravity, programmable in Python.
Run Antigravity CLI non-interactively to script agent tasks, integrate with CI pipelines, and capture machine-readable output.
Build AI agents that autonomously read files, run commands, edit code, and more.
